chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Miskān, from ʿAnbasah ibn Muṣʿab, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: If you doubt concerning the first two rakʿahs, then repeat.

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two rakʿahs, meaning two units of salat (prayer)
key_terms.فَأَعِدْ: then repeat, i.e. perform the prayer again

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one doubts the first two rakʿahs of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding doubt in salat (prayer). It states that if doubt occurs in the first two rakʿahs, the prayer is to be repeated, highlighting the special importance of certainty in the foundational units of prayer.
